title: 第16章 玄心果
content_zh:
韩榆一听孙康这话，心想到底还是孙师兄为人热忱，让人信得过。

    “暂时不必了，孙师兄，我今日过来的时候灵田内并没有发现偷灵鼠。”

    “兴许是已经走了吧，但愿不再出现了，要不然以你和李泉的情况，是真难对付那些畜生。”孙康说了一句。

    韩榆又迟疑一下，开口询问：“孙师兄，我最近感觉修炼缓慢，有点想要找一找帮助修炼的东西……孙师兄你知道要去什么地方找吗？”

    孙康顿时失笑：“韩师弟，你这问题，每一个杂役弟子或多或少都想过。当修行缓慢下来，每日苦熬也进展不多，又没有灵米支撑的时候，谁没想过能够获得灵药，一举提升修为，步入外门？”

    “不过能够得偿所愿的，可是少之又少。”

    “就比如我，要是知道什么地方能找到灵药让我突破到练气三层甚至四层，还不得天天守在那里？”

    “只是咱们万春谷本就是修仙宗门，又是南域五宗里面最看重灵药灵植的，对宗门附近的各类灵药那是向来搜索一空、没有遗漏；要想自己找到灵药，提升修为，比秃子头上找头发都难！”

    韩榆听到这里，也是恍然：难怪自己派出大小乌鸦搜索这些天，只找到两颗灵果，原来是万春谷已经特意搜寻过；单靠杂役弟子本身能力，碰巧去采到灵果，那是近乎绝无可能的。

    “那孙师兄，咱们万春谷附近有什么常见的灵药吗？”

    韩榆又问一句，孙康也忍不住乐了：“就知道你不会死心！”

    “说实话，每个杂役弟子都曾经有过这种幻想，包括我也是。”

    “让孙师兄你见笑了。”

    孙康摆摆手：“没事，反正我今日修行快到了灵根吸纳极限，就跟你说一说几种可能遇上的常见灵果吧。”

    他说的“吸纳极限”，韩榆近来也已经渐渐有所体会。

    各等灵根的修炼区别就在于此，灵根差一筹，不光是单纯运转功法吸纳灵气会明显缓慢、效果降低，连服用灵药、丹药等效果也会明显变差。

    就算是同等灵气、同等充裕资源，也是好的灵根容纳灵气更多、修行更快，差的灵根容纳灵气更少。

    这就是从一开始修行资质决定的，几乎是无可更改。

    当然了，大部分情况下，杂役弟子们是达不到吸纳极限的——他们向来比较缺少修炼资源。

    孙康这种有点积蓄、又借助青禾灵米成熟前灵气修炼的状态，也是一年中少有能“吃饱”、达到吸纳极限的时候。
content_en:
When Han Yu heard what Sun Kang said, he thought that after all, it was Senior Brother Sun who was so enthusiastic and trustworthy.

    "No need for the moment, Senior Brother Sun. When I came here today, no spirit-stealing rats were found in the spiritual field."

    "Perhaps he has left. I hope he will never show up again, otherwise it will be really difficult for you and Li Quan to deal with those beasts." Sun Kang said.

    Han Yu hesitated again and asked: "Senior Brother Sun, I feel that my cultivation has been slow recently, and I want to find something to help me with my cultivation... Senior Brother Sun, do you know where to look?"

    Sun Kang suddenly laughed: "Junior Brother Han, every handyman disciple has thought about your question at one time or another. When the practice slows down, the daily hard work makes little progress, and there is no support from spiritual rice, who has not thought about being able to obtain spiritual medicine, improve his cultivation level in one fell swoop, and step into the outer gate?"

    "But there are very few who can get what they want."

    "Just like me, if I knew where to find the elixir that would allow me to break through to the third or even fourth level of Qi training, why wouldn't I have to stay there every day?"

    "It's just that our Wanchun Valley is a sect that cultivates immortality, and among the five sects in the southern region, we value elixirs and plants the most. We have always searched for all kinds of elixirs near the sect and have not missed any. If you want to find elixirs yourself and improve your cultivation, it is harder than finding hair on a bald man's head!"

    When Han Yu heard this, he was also surprised: No wonder he sent crows and crows to search for these days, and only found two spiritual fruits. It turned out that Wanchun Valley had specially searched for them. It was almost impossible for the handyman disciples to pick the spiritual fruits by chance just by relying on their abilities.

    "Senior Brother Sun, are there any common elixirs near our Wanchun Valley?"

    Han Yu asked again, and Sun Kang couldn't help but feel happy: "I knew you wouldn't give up!"

    "To be honest, every handyman disciple has had this kind of fantasy, including me."

    "Brother Sun, let me make you laugh."

    Sun Kang waved his hand: "It's okay. Anyway, my practice today has almost reached the limit of spiritual root absorption. Let me tell you about some common spiritual fruits that you may encounter."

    Han Yu has gradually come to understand the "absorption limit" he mentioned recently.

    This is the difference between the cultivation of various spiritual roots. If the spiritual roots are inferior, not only will the simple operation of exercises to absorb spiritual energy be significantly slower and the effect reduced, but the effects of taking elixirs, elixirs, etc. will also be significantly worse.

    Even if they have the same spiritual energy and the same abundant resources, good spiritual roots can hold more spiritual energy and practice faster, while poor spiritual roots can hold less spiritual energy.

    This is determined by your cultivation qualifications from the very beginning and is almost irreversible.

    Of course, in most cases, the handyman disciples cannot reach the absorption limit - they have always been relatively short of cultivation resources.

    In this state of Sun Kang, who has some savings and uses Qinghe Lingmi to practice spiritual energy before it matures, it is also a rare time of the year when he can "eat full" and reach the limit of absorption.
